sanskrit: gurave ca gaṇeśāya kārtikeyāya dhīmatekārtikeyamasyaivāvighnaparisamāptyarthamabhivandatesamuddhṛtya satāṃ dhartuṃ hṛtkaṇṭhaśravaṇe sadādhartuṃ bindvādīni ratnāni siddhāntasamudrāduddhṛtyakṣantumarhanti tatsanto nāsūyā paricārakeratnāni sūtrairbaddhyante | tasmāt sadārādhanapravṛtte mayyasūyā na kartavyetiīśvarāṇāṃ śivānāṃ ca dhāraṇīyatayā dhiyāratnānīṣṭavidhānācca bindvādyāḥ śivaśāsaneadhvaitatprāptaye ṣoḍhā karṇyate parameṣṭhinātatprāptaye ca kalādiṣatprakāro'dhvā śivena śāstreṣu varṇyateyogāśca vividhāḥ karma nityanaimittikaṃ yathāetadeva parā kāṣṭhā mokṣākhyāṇorvicārataḥdhyeyaṃ ca yogamārgeṇa śaktipātoditātmabhiḥcaiṣāmāgamānumānayogipratyakṣa-siddhatvaṃ sūcayatina tābhyāṃ sadṛśaḥ kaścicchreya āptividhāyakaḥevāvadhāryamāptastu śiva evaikaḥ śivānye tvaśivā matāḥśivatvaṃ cātra sarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvamabhipretamkāmakāritayā'nyaistu nindyate paśuśāstravatguruṇā dīkṣito yadā | sarvajñaḥ sa śivo yadvat (vi0 1|21) itihetubhiḥ sādhyate kintu dhanyairāghrāyate sadāānandavipralabdhānāmānandopahitā citiḥavagāhya parānandalaharī yadi notkṣipettadvacanādetanna saṃbhavatītyarthaḥudakṣeṇordhvavaktreṇa tatastadavadhārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidyeśvarādīnāṃ śāstrāvabodhakatvātnahyatra śemuṣī śuddhā vipulāpi pragalbhatetasyātmasvarūpasya parīkṣaṇamapi siddhāntoktaireva hetubhiḥ kāryamiti bhāvaḥtrīṇi ratnāni ko vetti siddhānteta vinā svayamtadvad yogaṃ ca ko vetti sabījābījalakṣaṇamsarvān sādhakacittasthānāptaścintāmaṇiryathāphalāvāptiścetyarthaḥparīkṣā kriyate tatra bindurādau nirūpyatesa binduḥ paranādākhyaḥ nādabindvarṇakāraṇamaprāptaśivadhāmānastridhā vijñānakevalāḥsāmyāstrividhā eva vijñānakevalino bhavantitatra vidyābhujaḥ pūrve mantrā vidyāśca nāmataḥtatra prathame vidyātattvanivāsina ityāha- tatra vidyābhuja ititeṣāṃ purāṇi vidyāyāṃ vāmādīni yathottarampañcavidhakṛtyādhikāritvātmadhyāḥ praśāntakaluṣā vidyeśāḥ śivatejasaḥśivārkakarasaṃparkavikāsātmīyaśaktayaḥtathā purāṇi tatraiṣāmanantaḥ parameśvaraḥeṣāmananta eva parameśvaraḥpare sadāśivasamāḥ patikṛtyādhikāriṇaḥtattvameṣāmasūtāṅgapurabhogādiśobhitamityuktaṃ śrīmatpauṣkare- sādhakasya tu lakṣyārthaṃ tasya rūpamidaṃ smṛtam itiaṣṭādaśabhiradhvāyaṃ bhuvanaiḥ saha bhoktṛbhiḥśaktiśivatattvayośca sadāśivatattva evāntarbhāvo vijñeyaḥsadāśivāditattvaugho nityopādānakāraṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: eṣo'pi sadāśivādiradhvā vikārī, tato nityopādānakāraṇa itipārthivo'pi bhavet kumbho māyopādānakāraṇaḥsākṣānmṛdupādānatve'pi ghaṭasya paramparayā māyaivopādānakāraṇamitiyadyadutpadyate vastu tanmāyeyaṃ yathā kalāāptavākyenāpyetatsiddhamiti bhāvaḥpariṇāmo hi vastūnāṃ pūrvāvasthāparicyuteḥdadhnaśca takravat tatra takrāvasthā nirūpyatesadavasthaṃ hi vastvekaṃ pūrvaṃ kṣīraṃ tato dadhivistareṇa darśitaḥtattvatāttvikabhāvānāmupādānamanaśvaramghṛtakīṭanyāyenaikadeśenaiva māyā pariṇamata ityadoṣaḥna māyā neśvaro nāṇurna śaktiḥ śuddhavartmanaḥtathāhi māyā yā teṣāṃ kṣobhitā'nantatejasāprabhuḥ (vi0 3|27) itiaviśuddhajaḍatvena māyāmārgatayā tathāsakalāṇūpabhogyatvāt pariṇāmodayairapiniṣpādane kalādīnāṃ śarīrādisamanvitamsuvarṇamiva karmāraṃ makuṭotpādakarmaṇikṣobhyate'nantanāthena kumbhakāreṇa mṛd yathāsavikalpajñānaviṣaya eva śarīriṇāṃ kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti bhāvaḥsa tu śabdaścaturdhā vāgvaikharyādivibhedataḥ| tatra śabdopādānatvenāpi bindusiddhiḥvidyāśarīro bhagavānanantaḥ kṣobhako mataḥato na māyopādānaṃ tathaivāyaṃ maheśvaraḥātmā śaktiśca vijñeyau vistaro'trai?va vakṣyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cāsmābhistattvaprakāśavṛttaudṛśyante pudgalāḥ kecidalpajñānakriyānvitāḥpudgalaścetano nityo vikārarahito mataḥsiddhamāgameṣu śrūyate | ityato'sya na vikāraḥ saṃbhavatitathaiva ca citiḥ śaktistayorapyavikāriṇoḥvikāritvāt || (ślo0 19) iti | ata eva tayoraupādhikameva vaicitryamityāha- tayorapītisaṃpṛktā cidaṇoryena māyādyarthāvalokanenādākhyaṃ yatparaṃ bījaṃ sarvabhūreṣvavasthitam (1|5) itina karmaṇā'ṇorvaicitryamanapekṣeṇa jāyatepṛthivyādīnāmapyanupayogātkarmopabhogaṃ kurute vaicitryaṃ candanādayaḥsatyam, sādhanavaicitryadvāreṇaiva karma phalavaicitryaṃ karoti na kevalamityavirodhaḥpravṛttiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tyāgopādānakāraṇambhūtānāṃ pravṛttiḥ saṃbhavati, nānyathāśivānāmasamaiśvaryabhājāṃ bhogādhikārayoḥprāhuḥ, aparasya tatra pragamāsambhavātbindureva vikalpākhyāṃ savikalpakabuddhiṣuna cāyaṃ bhāvanāsaṃjñaḥ saṃskāro'dhyakṣabhāvataḥna buddheḥ pariṇāmo vā māyordhvamapi sambhavātsavikalpānubhavaḥ siddhaḥtataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ prakurute savikalpakabodhavānmāyākṣobhakatvam, na tu śivasya bindukṣobhavannirvikalpakamātreṇeti bhāvaḥanye vṛttiparīṇāmabhedavādaviśāradāḥguravo'nyathā sādhayantipariṇāmasya kartā'yaṃ na tu vṛttestatastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yato'yamanantaḥ pariṇāmasya kartā tatastathāvidhasavikalpakajñānavānityarthaḥiti jānāti yaḥ śaktaḥ sa kartā pariṇāmināmtathāhi sarvo nirdhūtavikalpamavalokayanityarthaḥanantenāpi śabdānuviddhavijñānapūrvakamsavikalpaṃ vijānāmītyavabodhābhimānataḥnirvikalpakabodhe'pi bindumīśo'dhitiṣṭhatina vṛttipariṇāmābhyāṃ kartṛbhedo'vadhāryatebindorapi tattvabhuvanādirūpeṇa pariṇāmaśrutervṛttipariṇāmayoratyantabhedābhāvāccaśabdatattvamaghoṣā vāg brahma kuṇḍalinī dhruvambindurevaṃ samākhyāto vyomānāhatamityapivaikharī madhyamābhikhyā paśyantī sūkṣmasaṃjñitāata āsāṃ kāraṇatvena binduḥ siddha ityarthaḥsthāneṣu vidhṛte vāyau kṛtavarṇaparigrahākevalaṃ buddhyupādānā kramād varṇānupātinīprāṇavṛttimatikramya vartate madhyamāhvayāsvayaṃprakāśā paśyantī māyūrāṇḍarasopamāiyaṃ cākṣarabindurūpetyuktamyasyāṃ dṛṣtasvarūpāyāmadhikāro nivartatenivṛttisiddheḥkevalaḥ paramānando dhīro nityoditaḥ prabhuḥsarvabhūtāntaracaraḥ śabdabrahmātmako raviḥtāmeva vāṇīṃ sūkṣmākhyāmāhurātmavido janāḥjaḍatvāt, tatsamavāye puruṣasyāpi vikāritvā'cetanatvādidoṣaprasaṅgātābhyo viviktamātmānaṃ nahi paśyanti pudgalāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāsvevātmabhrāntiriti bhāvaḥvaikharī śrotraje bodhe madhyamā savikalpaketasyā api samutpādanahetuḥ paśyantīyadāvṛttiraśeṣeṇa vilīnā cittasaṃśrayāatyantasaṃśleṣāt tadrūpeva bhātītyuktamna so'sti pratyayo'ṇūnāṃ yaḥ śabdānugamādṛtesaiṣā caturvidhā vṛttirnivṛttyādikalāśrayātbindusiddhiriti bhāvaḥnivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntiśca pañcamīsamastādhvavyāpikāḥ sthitā ityāha- yābhirvyāpto'dhvapañcakamititattvādhvā bhuvanādhvā ca varṇādhvā ca padātmakaḥvyomavyāpisaṃjñaḥ | mantrādhvā punaḥ saṃhitāmantrā evatyaktvaikamekaṃ saṃprāpya kalādiṣvajarāmaramkalādhvā varṇitaḥ pūrvaṃ nivṛttyādivibhedataḥsākārakāraṇāmātmabinduśaktiśivāśrayāmteṣu kālānalādīnāmanantāṇḍasya ṣaḍ bahiḥrudrāṇāṃ śatasaṃkhyānāṃ vīrabhadrasya copariekāśītipadā devī pratisargapadakramātmantrāvajātahṛdayau tatra sā tu parā kalāpañcādhvano vyāpya teṣveva vartata ityarthaḥpītaiṣā caturaśrā ca kaṭhinā vajralāñchitātatpralīnāṇusaṃghasya saṃkalpo vinivartatebrahmā'tra kāraṇaṃ mantraḥ sadyojāto'dhidevatābhūtāni pañca tanmātrāḥ pañca karmendriyāṇi caavyaktamapi varṇāśca hādiṭāntā vilomataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jalatejo'nilākāśabuddhyavyakteṣvahaṅkṛtauśiro vāmaśca mantrau dvau viṣṇuḥ kāraṇamucyatedhyātavyā galapadmāntarbahulālokaśālinīpratiṣṭhito yatastena pratiṣṭhā nāma sā kalāvidyāyāṃ sapta puruṣo rāgo niyatisaṃyutaḥmāyādibhuvanānāṃ ca vijñeyāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥpadāni viṃśatirmantrau śikhāghorau vyavasthitausā tu sphuradanekārcistrikoṇā svastikāṅkitātatpralīnāṇusaṃghasya saṃkalpo'śeṣagocaraḥśāntau tu trīṇi tattvāni daśāṣṭau bhuvanāni capadānyekādaśā'trāsan mantrau vaktratanucchadauṣaṭkoṇoditamalpāntasahasrakiraṇadyutiḥtatpralīnāṇusaṃghasya dveṣarāgādyabhāvataḥīśvaraḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra mantrastatpuruṣāhvayaḥatra ca trīṇi tattvāni pañcamī tu parā kalāvarṇā visargapūrvā ye ṣoḍaśa svarasaṃjñitāḥśāntyatītā ca pañcādhvāgarbhiṇī paramā kalāīśāno mantrarāḍenāmadhitiṣṭhati kāraṇamvyāpako bhuvanādīnāmabhivyāptaḥ sa bindunāsa hi devaḥ samāvṛtya svaśaktyā'nanyabhūtayāataḥ śakteḥ sarvajñānakriyārūpatvaṃ siddhamanyasyānyatra sadbhāvaḥ sarvadā'vyabhicāriṇīdvidhā sā sannidhāvekā paramātmavidhānataḥyathārko dinaceṣṭānāṃ sannidherupakārakaḥsaṅkalpamātreṇa kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vicitraiḥ pariṇāmaistairvidadhāti śiveritaḥyena yad vyāpyate vastu pariṇāmitayā svayambindunā vyāpyate yo'sau ṣaḍvidho'dhvā kalādikaḥbinduṃ gamayatīti bhāvaḥkecidācakṣate binduḥ samavaiti śive tataḥvyatirikteti bhāvaḥdve śaktī samavāyinyau śive jñānakriyātmikejñānaśaktyā vijānāti kriyayā kurute jagatśiva ityadhyāhāraḥtābhyāṃ na virahastasya te ca na staḥ śivaṃ vināīśā'dhikakriyāśaktyorvidyājñānātiriktayoḥjñānaśaktyādhikye'pi vidyātattvātmābhuvanāni vicitrāṇi svabhāvalalitāḥ priyāḥvidadhāti śivaḥ śakterananyāyāḥ kriyātmanaḥato nāyaṃ pṛthak śakteḥ śaktireva kriyātmikāso'yamātmani tattvaughamanekabhuvanāvalimbindurākhyāyate yuktyā pariṇāmī pradhānavatyathā kṣīraṃ jaḍatve'sya samavāyaḥ kathaṃ śiveityāha- jaḍatva itiśivasyānupamākhaṇḍacidghanaikasvarūpiṇaḥtvacetanatvādidoṣaprasaṅgātna tasya yuktiḥ śāstraṃ vā nātmā nāsti ca devatābhogamokṣakartṛtayā devatāpi na siddhyatikriyayā hetubhūtatvāt kriyāśaktiścideva yatkriyāhetubhūtatvād jñānaśaktireva kriyāśaktirucyata ityavirodhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jāyate'dhvā kutaḥ śuddhaḥ kva vā līyeta kena vāvijñānakevalāstredhā kathaṃ kasmācca te punaḥnahi cit pariṇāmena kurute tadaśeṣataḥetatprāgeva darśitam | sādhitaṃ cāsmābhistattvaprakāśavṛttau vistareṇasyādeṣa kalpitānekabhedaḥ kāryaviśeṣataḥśuddhādhvanastattvabhuvanādibhedaḥ satya eva, anyathopacārasyāpyayogātmāyeyo'pi tathā tu syādadhvā yuktyaviśeṣataḥprasiddhānadhvanaḥ śuddhān pratyācaṣṭe kathaṃ sudhīḥdurbuddhaya eveti bhāvaḥpravṛttirupabhogāya mokṣāya ca nigadyatemokṣārthaṃ vā''tmanāṃ pravṛttiryathā'dhikāraṃ dṛśyateprāpyate cittabhedena mokṣo vā'tha catuṣṭayātśrīmatṣaṭsāhasrikāyāmapi- dīkṣaiva mokṣadā puṃsāṃ cidabhivyaktikāriṇī itina tatra māyopādānaṃ tanubhogādi jāyatetatra sadāśivapada itikiñca māyā prayojyena kartrā kenāpyadhiṣṭhitāyathā mṛtkalaśādīnāṃ kulālena tathā hyasauajño janturanīśo'yamātmakārye'pi kīrtitaḥprayojyatvāccharīrādiyukto'nantaḥ kulālavatdeśādinā sa siddho'dhvā viśuddhaḥ śivaśāsanekalāvyāptasvarūpā ca pudgalādhiṣṭhitā ca yatpariṇatimāhuḥmahāmāyā bhavet tredhā tatra sthūlā guṇātmikābhogyāṃśca viṣayān paramparayotpādayantī prakṛtirucyatesūkṣmā kalāditattvānāmavibhāgasvarūpiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantrayoniḥ parā māyā nityā kuṇḍalinī tu yānityā, paramakāraṇatvātkāryātmikā sā māyeyaṃ pariṇāmavatī ca yatviśuddhasyādhvanaḥ siddhiranivāryā'vatiṣṭhatena teṣāmasito mārgaḥ kalāśuddhyā viśuddhyatitattvādīnāmato bindoḥ kāryamadhvā viśeṣataḥbhāvaḥanupādānarūpāṇāṃ kalānāṃ nityaśuddhayoḥityākhyātā mahāmāyā sarvādhvaprakṛtiḥ parāanye tu kathayantyatra māyāmadhvasvanaśvarīmkalāmutpādayāmāsa (1|6-7) ityādiśuddhiśca tādṛśī jñeyā tayorāgamavedibhiḥmantrayonirmahāmāyā yā parigrahavartinīproktavannādādidvāreṇā'dhiṣṭhitāḥseyaṃ kriyātmikā śaktirīśvarī sarvadoditāpāśātītaśivasamavāyenetipaśūn vartayate nityaṃ nānāyoniṣvaniścitātu nāśuddhayoniprāptirityarthaḥsā bhogasādhanopāyapratyayodayahetunāsarvathaivāmṛtaprāpteḥ pṛthakkāraṃ pratanvatīkarotītyarthaḥjñānaṃ parāmṛtopāyahetuḥ parikaraḥ paśoḥnirbījadīkṣāyāmapyācāryasya jñānapradhānatvātśabdarāśiśca bindūttho bindurnādādasāvapinādabindvādikrameṇa śabdotpattirityuktam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra bhoktṛtayā bhogaiḥ śarīrendriyagocaraiḥvicchinnāvārakamalānāmeva tatsaṃbhavātmāyaiva kāraṇaṃ śuddhāśuddhayormalakarmaṇoḥbindorviveke sahasā cchidyate malakambukaḥsaṃbhavāccādhikāramalakṣayastadviveke bhavatiuttīrṇamāyamātmānaṃ mahāmāyānuṣaṅgiṇamśarīrādīnyutpādayatītyarthaḥyathodadhiruparyeva vikarotyanileraṇātsvakāryarūpābhiḥ kalābhiḥ prāguktaṃ viśvaṃ vyāpnoti cetyarthaḥevaṃ māyaikadeśena vikaroti tathākhilampragamaḥ saṃbhavatyevatatrākṣubdhe bhaved bhogo bindāvānandarūpiṇisvarūpaniṣṭhe śakterapyupasaṃhṛtavyāpāratvāllayaḥekaiva khalu cicchaktiḥ śivasya samavāyinītayaitayā'bhisaṃbandhādeko devastridhā bhavetśaktirapratighodāramarīcinicayātmikānirāvaraṇanirdvandvanirupādānavaibhavāśāntoditaprapañcādibinduvyāptipaṭīyasīādimadhyāntarahitā rahitā sarvabandhanaiḥcitireva matāmlānamahimā parameṣṭhinaḥtayaitayā'bhisambandhaviśeṣānnityarūpayābindurāpūrayannādairāṇavaṃ cinnabho muhuḥvikaroti yathā lolaiḥ kallolairnādayannabhaḥekānekavibhāgeva kāryabhedād vibhāvyateicchākāryamanicchāpi kurvāṇecchā cidavyayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñeyakāryādyupādhibhedāt tasyā jñānākriyādibheda ityarthaḥyad yasyāḥ kāryamāmnāyalokābhyāmavadhāritamkāmānapi bahūnekaḥ kalpavṛkṣaḥ prayacchatitathā'nāhitasaṃskāraviśeṣaikasvarūpiṇīna jāyate na mriyate kṣīyate na ca vardhateutpadyate naśyati vā cinotyapacinoti caśarīrādi tathā nāsau tasmānnaiṣā vikāriṇībodhaśakterabodhasya pariṇāmo hi dṛśyatesamavāyena tādātmyānnahi cit pariṇāminīśaktirnā'cetanā citaḥ (mṛ0 vi0 3|4) itisattve kāraṇaśūnyatvādapi binduvadiṣyateasyāścānityatve'navasthāprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥyatsiddhau jagataḥ siddhiryadasiddhau na kiñcanapramāṇena sādhyate ? kāryotpattyanyathānupapattyaiva sā siddhetyabhiprāyaḥtāmetāmadvayāmeke kīrtayanti vipaścitaḥdvaitapratibhāso dvicandrādijñānavad bhrānta evetiyathā rajjurahicchidramālāvibhramakāriṇījñānamātraṃ tathaiveyamekānekāyate bhramātvicārāllūnamūlatvādaheturbandhamokṣayoḥnityamuktādvayānantasaṃvidevāsti kevalamvyavahārastu bhedātmā vijñeyo vaṭayakṣavatbālamūkādivijñānatulyaivākalpanārthajāprāmāṇyābhyupagamād bhedasya ca vikalparūpatvānna pratyakṣasiddhatvamityarthaḥyad viśeṣaṇavijñānaṃ śabdasaṃskārapūrvakamarthasāmarthyajaṃ jñānaṃ smṛtisaṅkalpavanmatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratyakṣa eva tāvarthe vikalpaviṣayāvapibhedapratibhāsaḥmucyate tebhya evāyaṃ bandhamokṣau na vastutaḥgurubhiḥ pratibodhyante siddhāntāgamadāyibhiḥsādhyeta taireva dṛḍhaṃ tasyāḥ syāt sadvitīyatābhāvaḥaprasiddhasya dharmasya siddhyai vyāptyupabṛṃhitāḥtataḥ pṛthageva bhedena dharmyādayaḥ siddhā abhyupagantavyāḥsiddhyasiddhī ca saṃbhūya naikatra sthātumarhataḥsādhyasiddhiḥtadabhāvataḥprayukto bhedamākhyāti prayogaḥ svāṅgasiddhayesvāṅgasya hetvādeḥ siddhyarthamityarthaḥdvaitabhāvastato'nyatra siddhyet siddhāvapi dhruvamāgamo'pi tadaistaistaiḥ smāritārthaviśeṣataḥyadyadvayeyaṃ saṃvittiḥ svena syādabhidhitsitānivāryamāṇamaṅgaiḥ svairadvaitakṣapaṇakṣamaiḥvartamānā hi dṛśyante gauṇe'rthe lokavedayoḥnaivaṃ heturaduṣṭāyāṃ vyāptau sādhyaṃ na sādhayetmukhyamapyapahāyārthaṃ nutiṃ kurvanti saṃvidaḥbhedaṃ parebhyo vyāvṛttirūpaṃ yonopajāyatesavikalpamasandigdhaṃ vyabhicāravivarjitamagṛhītārthabhedasya tannāmādiviśeṣavatpāvakamanudhāvediti sarva(masa)mañjasamsāmānye siddhasādhanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhedaḥ siddhyedathānanyabhāva evaṃ ca sādhyatebheda eva sādhyaterajjūdāharaṇaṃ śiṣyasammohāyaiva kevalamrajjūdāharaṇamanarthakamevetyarthaḥvivartamānā tairbhāvairjñānamātranivartakaiḥbhogasāmyavimokṣādidoṣaprasaṅgādityuktamasmābhiranyatramaloparuddhadṛkśakternarasyevoḍurāṭ paśoḥmalaruddhajñānaśakterekaiva cetanātmikā saṃvidanekarūpeva vivartata itiekamindumanekāṃstān bhūyobhūyaḥ samīkṣateapi tiktaṃ vijānāti payaḥ karaṇadoṣataḥviduṣāmapi nīloṣṇapratyayāvavivekataḥvivartamānā jāteti naṣṭeti vividheti catacchivapraṇidhānena śivaśāstroditena catimirādiryathārogyaśāstroktenaiva karmaṇāabādhitaḥ pramāṇaiśca vivartaḥ syāt kathaṃ citeḥtasmād vivartate saṃvidaṇūnāmeva bandhanātatadrūpāpi tadrūparūpiṇīvā'nubhūyateanyonyādhyāsasādhyatvādavivekakṛtodayaḥāropyātmani tadvṛttivikārānavikāriṇīsasukheti saduḥkheti svātmānaṃ darśayatyaṇoḥavivekena jānāti bālo'haṃ kṛśa ityataḥbhrāntipradhānasantānakandaścijjaḍavastunoḥvivartabhedā yujyerannantarā dṛḍhabandhanamsā ca māyāyā mohakatvādanātmādāvātmābhimānarūpetiaṇoreva na sarveṣāmato bandhastayormataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tayościjjaḍayoranyonyaguṇādhyāse bandha eva niyāmaka iti śeṣaḥna tāni punaranyasya karaṇāni tayostathābuddhirna sarvā sarveṣāṃ tena bandhastayormataḥpuṃsopabhujyate tena tayorbandho niyāmakaḥtena bandho'sti bandhaśca pṛthageveśiturmataḥgalite sarvathā bandhe vimukte cāṇave malebandhamokṣaśca śivaprasādādevetyuktamsarvāvaraṇanirmuktā śaktireṣā mahīyasīparasaṃvitsvarūpāyāḥ śakterasati bandhanetathātve muktasyā'pi sukhaduḥkhādisaṃvedanena bhoktṛtvaprasaṅgātato vimuktāḥ sarvajñā na tu cinmātravedinaḥna tu svasaṃvedanamātraniṣṭhāḥ, api tu śivavat sarvajñā evetitamasācchādyamānā hi na te muktā bhavanti cajāyate malaruddhānāmaṇūnāmarthadarśanenirvikalpārthasaṃvittistadaharjātabālavatyathārthasthitiṃ gṛhṇāti svasaṃvedyā cidavyayāśaktyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ paśyatyātmā gatāvṛtiḥ || (ślo0 111) itinahi kartṛbahutvasya gamakaṃ vidyate kvacitnirvartyamānatvād rāgadveṣādirahitatvācca na pravartantesaṃvidāśrayate śaśvacchivaṃ paramakāraṇamtirodadhāti bhagavānanugṛhṇāti cātmanaḥśaktimānāhitodyogaḥ pravṛttaśceti deśikaiḥtasmin mukulitevāste kriyākhyā śaktiraiśvarīparabindusvarūpādhiṣṭhāturlayāvasthocyatepatyurāviṣkarotyuccaiḥ paramānandasantatim
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sukhasaṃvedanarūpo vyākhyeyaḥ, nirmalatvena śivasyopādhibhūtayostayorasambhavātpañcamantratanuḥ śrīmān devaḥ sakalaniṣkalaḥityādinā | eṣo'rthaśca śrīmanmataṅge vistareṇa darśita iti tata evāvadhārayitavyaḥmantrarūpā hi tacchaktirmananatrāṇadharmiṇīvācakaśabdānāmupacāreṇa mantraśabdaprayogaḥsā bhāti binduśāntyādipañcādhiṣṭheyagocarābhogasthānāni pañcaiṣāṃ bindusaṃjñā śiveritābhogasthānatayetyuktamityavirodhaḥtadgocarā parā mūrtiraparā kāryagocarāmūrtirityarthaḥsaiva mūrtiḥ kriyābhedāt sādākhyā tanurucyateityarthaḥbhogasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ nirmalānāṃ śivātmanāmtatkāryaṃ sā kriyāśaktirasāvapi tathocyateicchājñānakriyādyā yatprabhavāḥ kāryayonayaḥityarthaḥdehendriyādayaḥ śuddhāḥ subhagāḥ svadhikārakāḥtatsaṃbandhācchivo'śeṣakāryāṇāṃ heturucyatepatikṛtyādhikāreṣu sadāśivamaheśvarāndhyeyatāṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥpañcasrotomukhaḥ śāntaḥ prabhuḥ śaktiśirāḥ śivaḥīśānamūrdhā puṃvaktro daśadigbāhumaṇḍalaḥpravṛttimānayaṃ devaḥ sakalaḥ sarvapāvanaḥlayabhogādhikāreṣu tau hi cinmātrarūpiṇausvātmani pravilīyante tenaike samadhiṣṭhitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: layāvasthaśivasamatvāllayāvasthābhāja ucyantesamāliṅgya mahāmāyāmapare vṛttiśālinīmśāntyādibhuvanarūpeṇa pariṇatāṃ mahāmāyāmāśritya vartanta ityarthaḥtathā pare paravyoma samāśrityādhvamūrdhaniśivājñayā pañcakṛtyakāriṇo bhavantītyuktamtataḥ sa teṣāmeko'pi layabhogādhikāriṇāmtadvadeva matā śaktistayorbhedo'dhunocyatesamāśrayaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ svaniṣṭhaghanacinmayaḥdharmadharmitayaivānayorbhedaḥparamaiśvaryarūpā ca mahimā vyāptirūpiṇīprakaṭayati- tayoritiparānapekṣaṃ rūpaṃ yadvijñānaṃ śivasaṃjñitamparāpekṣaṃ viṣayāpekṣamityarthaḥākāradvayasaṃvittiraśeṣasyāpi vastunaḥsvasaṃvedanasiddhatvādetat siddhamityarthaḥ | ataścāsti śaktiritinityoditānavacchinnavibhūterīśvarasya yattena śaktiḥ parāpekṣaṃ rūpamīśasya yujyatekāryaputrādirūpāṇāmanyathaivopalambhanātpitrāderviṣayādisāpekṣeṇaiva jñānādinotpattidarśanādityarthaḥvirodhenātha paryāyānnaivamapyavināśi yatpariṇāmaḥavināśi ca tannityamiṣṭamasmād vibhidyatekāraṇāt tathā dharmātmikaiva śaktirityarthaḥkāryopādhivaśācchaktisaṃjñā syādapi cidghanedharmirūpameva paramārthaṃ na tu dharmarūpamityarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karaṇena vinā kāryaṃ kurvan kartā bhaveditina śaktyanyat (vi0 3|4) iti | evamātmanāmapi dehaspandādau śaktireva karaṇamityuktamkiñcāgṛhītamapi cedupādhiḥ kāryamīśituḥkathaṃ vāyaṃ bhavet kartā kāraṇajñānavarjitaḥidamandhatamaḥ kṛtsnamantarā śaktidīpikāmananyāpi tathā śambhorvibhinnā śaktiriṣyatetādātmyasaṃbandhānnātmāntaravad bheda ityāha- nāpi bhinnoktetiananyā'pi vibhinnā'taḥ śambhoḥ sā samavāyinīnahyeṣa bhagavān śaktyā svātmano'tyantabhinnayācicchaktiyuktatvenaiva darśanātanāhitaviśeṣo'pi heturdevo maheśvaraḥbinduḥ pralīnakāryo'sau śivaśaktisamīritaḥcirasthāpitaviśvo hi bindureva pravartatemṛdavasthāntarāpattyā pūrvamevamasāvapikāryabhedāya ghaṭate nirvikāre'pi śūlinibhedasaṃśoṣacūrṇānāmavasthābhedajanmanāmkartā sargādikāryāṇāmavikāro'pi śaktimāndravatāśuṣkatāheturavikāro'pi bhāskaraḥaṇūnāmavikāro'pi bandhamokṣakaraḥ śivaḥkarmaṇoḥ sannipātena śaivī śaktiḥ patatyaṇaubhogataḥ || (6|19) iti | malaparipāke satyanugrāhikāyāḥ pātaḥpraśāntamalakāluṣyamātmānamanupaśyatimalāvaraṇāpagamāt tadvimuktaṃ sarvajñatvādirūpamasya prakāśata ityarthaḥnityanaimittikenaiṣa karmaṇā vartate paramprāpnuvanti mahādhīrā dhanyā hi śivayoginaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00009 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yogābhyāsādatraiva sarvajñatvādiḥ prakāśata ityarthaḥnadījanapadodyānapurādīni svalīlayānamastathāvidhāyāsmadgurave śivatejaserāmakaṇṭhakṛtālokanirmalīkṛtacetasāratnatrayaparīkṣārthaḥ saṃkṣepeṇa prakāśitaḥ
